topic: What a 7-day water-only fast does to the body (proteomics study)
title: What a week without food does to you #shorts
lines: What happens to your body if you stop eating for a whole week?
Scientists tracked twelve adults who drank only water for seven days.
On day one, you're still running on sugar.
By day two or three, your body flips to burning stored fat.
Around day three, about one in three of the three thousand blood proteins they measured started to change.
Across every major organ. Even ones that support your brain.
They lost almost six kilos, and the fat loss stuck.
Please don't try this without a doctor.
description: Twelve people drank only water for 7 days, and on day 3 their blood changed in a way nobody expected. 🧠 #science #humanbody #fasting #health #shorts
